objective: Close only freshly reproduced page264 deltas with at most one WordPress write, then use remaining safe capacity for read-only acceptance without reopening passed work.
hard_scope: Additional CSS is allowed only when every effect selector is explicitly body.page-id-264 scoped.
No other page, global header/footer, shared media, shared plugin setting, SMTP, notification, webhook or real form submission may be modified/tested from this package.

actions: Read the exact rolling usage/remaining counter; never reuse +4 history.
phase_0_connection_and_budget.stop: If connection is not confirmed or exact remaining capacity cannot cover the selected package plus 10-call D11 reserve, perform no WordPress write.

actions: Read page264 _elementor_data length/SHA256/JSON validity only and reconcile against 48874 B / 09f661e095714c1b3149c40406d7f31f04887c49a392f59c7c41b11fee3a788a / valid.
Read compact Hello Additional CSS marker/hash inventory without round-tripping the full 600KB+ field through chat.
Require af-project:end=1, af-oldtrees-visual-v004=1, af-oldtrees-visual-v005=1; record v006/v007 counts.
If cheap in the same safe window, read ID33 active/hash and require the last accepted page guard behavior before semantic claims.
stop_conditions: Unexpected page264 hash/JSON drift -> reconcile; do not restore stale data.
Unexpected marker multiplicity or missing project end -> reconcile; do not insert CSS.
ID33 drift that changes page264 semantics -> reconcile before interaction/AX acceptance.

phase_2_two_tab_live_visual_gate.browser: Reuse exactly one reference and one target tab. Open zero replacements. Stop if connector disconnects or tabs are repurposed by another process.

checks.v006: At #ajanlatkeres, compare green contact-button label/value foreground. Failure only if target remains dark while source is white under matched state.
checks.v007: At Kivágás vagy átalakítás?, compare desktop card column widths/wrapping under matched viewport. Failure only if target remains unequal while source is equal.

phase_3_at_most_one_write.method: One guarded match-once insertion immediately before the unique af-project:end marker.
rules: Selected marker(s) must be absent before insert.
Do not rewrite or replay v004/v005 or any older oldtrees visual bundle.
Do not modify page264 Elementor data to solve these two cascade defects.
HTTP 429 write response means UNKNOWN outcome; do not retry until exact marker/hash readback.

actions: Read back selected new marker(s) exactly once and af-project:end exactly once.
Re-read page264 data hash/JSON and require unchanged accepted content baseline.
Fresh targeted source/target capture of only the changed section(s) and adjacent preserved geometry.
For v006 require white foreground with unchanged contact-button size/shape and joined panel geometry.
For v007 require equal columns/source-like wrapping while preserving v005 beige/sage surfaces, equal height, icons and bullets.

phase_5_read_only_form_acceptance.prerequisite: Only if calls remain safely above D11 reserve after mandatory closeout.
phase_5_read_only_form_acceptance.action: Inspect Form33 service/topic radio schema/runtime to prove whether submission-time required validation already exists.
phase_5_read_only_form_acceptance.rule: Change nothing if already enforced. If not enforced, document the exact native control/hook owner first; do not combine a form write into the visual CSS write.
phase_5_read_only_form_acceptance.forbidden: No real submission, SMTP, notification, webhook or external delivery test.

phase_6_interaction_acceptance.rule: Interaction proof does not require a WordPress write. Run only in an interaction-capable stable browser; do not add duplicate JS because the current Opera connector lacks click/keyboard actions.

phase_7_hero_diagnostic.rule: Diagnostic only until exact page264 owner/cascade is proven. No arbitrary -40px margin/transform or blanket padding correction.

phase_8_formal_visual_acceptance.contract: Same browser engine, viewport, DPR, zoom, fonts/images/load state, scroll and moving-content state. Produce source, target, overlay/diff and key geometry. Do not resize/crop to conceal differences.
phase_8_formal_visual_acceptance.result_rule: PIXEL_PASS remains false until this deterministic matrix exists.

call_economy.preferred_combination: Combine compact read-only server facts in as few supported WPVibe calls as possible; if both visual deltas fail, deploy both in one guarded CSS write.
call_economy.estimated_core_calls: Approximately 5-8 for connection/preflight/write/readback depending on supported compact reads and whether a write is needed.
do_not_spend_for: full Additional CSS round-trip when a compact marker/hash query suffices
cache purge without demonstrated stale render
rechecking already-passed content/semantics merely to collect duplicate evidence

stop_conditions: WPVibe unavailable/disabled -> no WordPress write; continue repository/static preparation only.
Opera unstable/disconnected/repurposed -> stop browser testing and preserve the two-tab memory policy.
Fresh state contradicts repository baseline -> reconcile first; never force the documented state onto newer live truth.
Two attempted fixes without measurable improvement -> stop iteration and re-diagnose ownership/cascade.
